content.text: {"abstained":false,"abstention_reason":"","answer":"The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas (MOPNG) introduced and oversees the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 scheme [E01][E02]. The ministry launched the scheme to provide free LPG connections to women from poor households, with the objective of promoting clean cooking fuel among rural and deprived families [E01][E02]. Under PMUY 2.0, the ministry expanded the scheme to reach more beneficiaries across India, including an additional allocation of 1.6 Crore LPG connections with special facilities for migrant households [E01].
